articles.summary: Heritage Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: HFWA) (the "Company" or "Heritage") anticipates issuing its third quarter earnings release on Thursday, October 22, 2026 before the market opens. The Company has scheduled a conference call to discuss the third quarter earnings on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific time (12:00 p.m. Eastern time). There will be a live question-and-answer session following the presentation. Participants may register for the call using the link below to receive dial-in details and their own unique dial-in code. It is recommended you join 10 minutes prior to the start time. Register for the call with the below link: https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/562330083?pwd=MlXLXIj8 You may also access the conference call utilizing the numbers listed below: Live Conference Call (833) 461-5787 Meeting ID: 562 330 083 The conference call will be recorded and will dialing (833) 309-1852 for replay twenty-four hours a day ending November 5, 2026.
